text:
maria.g: Quick sync — NovaFinance POC: they want SAML (IdP-initiated), SCIM delta provisioning, RBAC mapped to Okta groups, and per-tenant domain proofing. Also asked for ballpark cost difference between Hosted vs Dedicated. Anyone able to own runbook + pricing for presales?

alex.l: I can take infra/runbook. What are their expected SCIM churn and provisioning cadence? that affects throttling and whether Dedicated makes sense.

sam.k: Sales note: ~20k users total, ~5k DAU, weekly bulk syncs (full upsert), regular delta updates during business hours. 3 apps using SSO. Data residency must be EU-only.

emily.p: SGTM. For SCIM we typically recommend a 2h window for a full bulk upsert, deltas in realtime with throttling. I'll draft two presales options: Hosted (standard quotas), Hosted+scim-quota bump, and Dedicated with reserved SCIM throughput. Need to confirm JIT vs SCIM-only provisioning preference.

maria.g: They also require delegated admin for tenant owners and custom RBAC roles. Can Redwood map Okta groups -> role claim in SAML assertion? also need nested group handling clarity.

alex.l: Yes — we can emit group claims in the SAML assertion via attribute mappings. For SCIM group->role sync we support basic group membership sync; nested groups are not flattened on our side, recommend flattening at IdP or a short sync script. Caveat noted in runbook.

sam.k: Another ask: domain proofing for multiple brands/subdomains vs a single umbrella domain. They want to onboard tenants quickly; is wildcard/delegated domain verification supported?

emily.p: Current product supports exact domain verification per tenant. Wildcard/delegated proofing isn't GA. We can offer delegated proofing as an engineering engagement tied to Dedicated/private control plane — estimate 4–6 weeks for delivery as a custom scope. I'll mark it as optional work item in the proposal.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Draft dedicated quote uploaded: https://redwood.s3/quotefiles/novafinance-dedicated-quote-v1.pdf :eyes:

maria.g: :thumbsup: I'll attach the security questionnaire answers and prepare the POC runbook: steps for SAML metadata exchange, SCIM delta replay script, test users, and RBAC verification plan.

alex.l: I'll add a sample SCIM delta curl and a SAML metadata snippet to the runbook. Example SCIM PATCH snippet for delta replay:
```
curl -X PATCH "https://api.redwood.com/scim/v2/Users/123" \\ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\ 
  -d '{"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"emails","value":[{"value":"alice@nova.example"}]}]}'
```

sam.k: Sales needs a ballpark cost to keep momentum. can we give a top-line now?

emily.p: Ballpark figures (pre-final PM review): Hosted + standard SCIM = ~$1.2k/mo; Hosted with higher SCIM quota = ~$3k/mo; Dedicated POC (one-time setup) = $25k; Dedicated recurring (reserved throughput) = ~$8k/mo. Rough numbers only — quote to be validated.

maria.g: Great — I'll update CRM, attach runbook draft, and schedule the tech call for Wed 10am PT. adding mike-sec and laura-ops to the invite.

alex.l: will upload runbook bits to the shared drive after this thread.

sam.k: i'll send the calendar invite and include the draft quote link.
